major_events: Su Ming regains his Shikong clone (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1174章 重获噬空): Su Ming approaches the Nine Burning Incense array and successfully regains his Shikong clone.
Su Ming is trapped in the Hall of All Spirits (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1183章 四年): Su Ming survives four years inside the Hall of All Spirits by hunting down mutant beasts and consuming their blood.
Su Ming embarks on the path to Lingxian status (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1185章 生之路): Su Ming initiates his first ascension to Lingxian status guided by the residual will of the Tianling elder.
Su Ming declares himself the Barbarian God (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1194章 我是蛮族蛮神！！): During his trial in the Daming Tribe memories, Su Ming proclaims his role as the Barbarian God.
Su Ming achieves Lingxian status and returns (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1206章 回归道晨): Su Ming successfully completes his first ascension, gaining immense soul strength and returning to the Daochen Great World.
Su Ming subjugates the South Alliance (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1214章 七绝化阴阵): Su Ming defeats the South Alliance's Seven Extremes Yin Transformation Array and enslaves the Ancient God Taga.
The possession battle for Daochen Great World (第五卷 我的道晨界 第1225章 夺舍道晨（三）): Su Ming competes with Su Xuanyi and the original Will to possess the Daochen Great World.
Su Ming returns to Nanze Island (第六卷 三荒劫 第1236章 南泽岛): Su Ming returns to the Land of Yin Death and is welcomed by the survivors of the Barbarian race.
Su Ming slays the Yidao Sect White Robe envoy (第六卷 三荒劫 第1247章 灭杀白袍！): Su Ming kills the Yidao Sect White Robed messenger, obtaining information on the cosmic butterfly.
Su Ming meets the Sangzi butterfly (第六卷 三荒劫 第1272章 雷辰！): Su Ming meets the black butterfly representing his childhood friend Lei Chen in the star sky.
The origin of San Huang is revealed (第六卷 三荒劫 第1279章 他的名字，叫……三荒！): The Sang Xiang Will reveals that the Will of San Huang was originally a cultivator who possessed its left wing.
Su Ming performs his second ascension (第六卷 三荒劫 第1284章 再升先！): Su Ming goes to the Hall of All Spirits inside the Sang Xiang world to perform his second ascension.
The climax of the San Huang Kalpa (第六卷 三荒劫 第1379章 绝不放弃！): Su Ming refuses to surrender his companions to Xuan Zang, who holds the Niling Beads.
Bald Crane's sacrifice and transformation (第六卷 三荒劫 第1380章 秃毛鹤的选择): Bald Crane merges with its body to become the Seventh Reverse Spirit to save Su Ming.
Su Ming initiates the possession of Xuan Zang (第六卷 三荒劫 第1380章 秃毛鹤的选择): Su Ming shatters his own body to possess Xuan Zang, projecting his soul into the Ancient Zang dreamworld.
Su Ming possesses Wang Tao and joins the July Sect (第七卷 几多轮回少一人 第1385章 七月血): Su Ming enters the July Sect inner trial by possessing a deceased youth named Wang Tao.
The awakening of the July Sect elders (第七卷 几多轮回少一人 第1390章 是谁将我唤醒！): Lan Lan wakes up Xu Zhongfan, who suffers backlashes from Su Ming's destiny and wakes up the other 11 elders.
Bei Qiong urges Su Ming to wake up (第七卷 几多轮回少一人 第1389章 我叫德顺): Bei Qiong (Deshun) recognizes Su Ming's soul shadow and warns him that the Sang Xiang world was a dream.
The battle against the Yidao Sect (第七卷 几多轮回少一人 第1408章 否则……战！): Yidao Sect's Senmu Grand Daozun attacks the July Sect, but first elder Gu Tai defends and repels them.
Su Ming probes the First Prince's identity (第七卷 几多轮回少一人 第1414章 我已知你是谁！): Su Ming uses Time Reversal on Wu Kun to project his mind and discover that the First Prince is the Miesheng Old Man.
Gu Tai summons Su Ming to the 7th heaven (第七卷 几多轮回少一人 第1415章 逆灵珠！): Gu Tai summons Su Ming to outline the five royal competition preparation tasks.
character_state_transitions: Su Ming (Regaining Shikong Clone): From lacking his primary clone to regaining the Shikong clone in Chapter 1174, restoring his dual-realm combat strength.
Su Ming (Toxic Black Blood): From a normal body to a state where his blood is black and toxic due to consuming mutant beasts in Chapter 1183, which speeds up his healing.
Su Ming (Breakthrough to Lingxian): From a standard Yuan Realm cultivator to a Lingxian in Chapter 1206, increasing his soul density tenfold and mastering the Sheng Realm.
Su Ming (Cosmic Will Possession): From a mortal cultivator to possessing three-tenths of the Daochen Great World's Will in Chapter 1225.
Xu Hui (Estranged Stranger): From Su Ming's beloved companion to a cold, hostile leader of the South Alliance in Chapter 1214 with no memories of him.
Lei Chen (Sangzi Butterfly): From a childhood friend to the silent black butterfly in Chapter 1272, carrying a sad awareness of their separate paths.
Bald Crane (Becoming Kong Mo): From a greedy bird to the Seven-Colored Peacock (Kong Mo / Seventh Reverse Spirit) in Chapter 1380, merging with its body to save Su Ming.
Su Ming (Possessing Xuan Zang): From a physical cultivator to a shattered soul form inside Xuan Zang's body in Chapter 1380, launching the Suming Possession.
Su Ming (Disguised as Wang Tao): From a formless possessing soul to a low-profile July Sect disciple in Chapter 1385 to hide from the elders.
Xu Zhongfan (Backlash and Aging): From a majestic middle-aged man in Chapter 1390 to a withered old man due to destiny backlash when attempting to accept Su Ming as disciple.
Bei Qiong (Fading Boatman): From an active pill-peddling old man in Chapter 1389 to a fading shadow wearing a rain cloak and bamboo hat, revealing his boatman identity.
long_form_mechanisms: Ascension to Lingxian (升先/升灵): A mechanism in the Hall of All Spirits where a candidate merges with ancestral spirit seats in a specific order; success yields a tenfold increase in soul density, while failure results in turning into a mindless spirit.

Cosmic Butterfly Architecture (桑相蝴蝶): The macrocosm consists of a giant butterfly named Sang Xiang whose left wing is the San Huang Great World and right wing is the Sang Xiang Great World; their periodic overlapping causes a destructive Kalpa.
San Huang's Possession (三荒夺舍): The sleeping will of San Huang (originally a cultivator) awakens during the wing overlap to possess the right wing, forcing the Sang Xiang Will to hide.

Double-World Soul Resonance (双界二重魂): Every soul has a copy on each wing. Merging the two halves makes the soul complete and immune to Kalpa destruction, while traversing the Yin Death corridor without proper integration causes disintegration.
Niling Beads (逆灵珠): A string of nine beads held by Xuan Zang, each representing one of the nine Reverse Spirits; capturing a Reverse Spirit seals it inside its corresponding bead.

Suming Possession (塑冥夺舍): The innate talent of the Suming Clan to shatter their physical body and possess a target from within, creating a projected spiritual battleground where the target's memories and identity are projected.

Seven Lives Art and Destiny Backlash (七命术与命格反噬): A July Sect technique where the master's fate is linked to the disciple; if the disciple has a royal destiny, the master suffers severe backlash, requiring multiple elders to share the burden.

Royal Prince Competition (夺嫡之争): A tradition in the Ancient Zang Kingdom where princes travel for 6,000 years, then return to fight for the throne; the survivor's coronation elevates the realms of their supporting cultivators.

Time Reversal Art (岁月逆转之术): A Suming clan technique used by Su Ming to reverse time locally, cancelling out self-destruction sequences or using a target's memory and blood as a physical bridge to project his mind.
continuity_observations: Lei Chen's Rattle and Su Xuanyi's Scheme: Su Xuanyi's scheme is elaborated in Chapter 1188, revealing he created a rattle for Lei Chen just like Su Ming's to facilitate the possession of Miesheng Old Man.

Bei Qiong's True Identity as Deshun: The old pill-peddler Bei Qiong in the July Sect is revealed to have the true name Deshun in Chapter 1389, who was Xu Hui's servant in the South Alliance in Chapter 1214.

Bei Qiong's Shadow and the Boatman: In Chapter 1389, Bei Qiong's shadow is described as wearing a rain cloak and bamboo hat, linking him directly to the boatman who has been monitoring Su Ming's soul.

First Prince's Dual Identity: In Chapter 1414, the First Prince is revealed to look exactly like the Miesheng Old Man but carries a trace of Lei Chen's aura, aligning with Su Xuanyi's plan to have Lei Chen possess Miesheng.
Xu Hui's hostile estrangement: In Chapter 1214, Xu Hui is hostile and treats Su Ming as a stranger, matching the tragedy of their separation and memory wipes.
Yu Xuan's Slumber in Yingxiang: In Chapter 1280, Su Ming finds the right-wing clone of Yu Xuan sleeping in the Yingxiang True World but cannot wake or take her because she would disintegrate.
The 13 July Sect Elders and Gu Tai: In Chapter 1415, it is revealed that 12 of the July Sect grand elders are actually Gu Tai's disciples, explaining his absolute authority in the sect.

The Nine Incense Burners and the Hall of All Spirits: The Nine Burning Incense where Su Ming's Shikong clone is held in Chapter 1174 is later revealed to connect directly with the Hall of All Spirits, establishing a consistent link.
style_observations: Melancholic and Solitary Tone: The writing style consistently emphasizes isolation and sorrow, particularly during Su Ming's reflections on Wushan's snow and the fading of childhood friendships.

Philosophical and Circular Metaphors: Er Gen utilizes grand philosophical inquiries about the nature of existence, using the metaphor of the butterfly's wings and the dream-possibilities to challenge the reader's perception of reality.

Foreshadowing via Repetitive Phrases: The text frequently uses repetitive, rhythmic phrases such as '曾经……' or '那是……' to create a lyrical, nostalgic rhythm, particularly during emotional confrontations.

Contrast between Cold and Heat: The author contrasts thermal extremes (the red, burning heat of the Hall of All Spirits vs the cold, freezing wind of the July Sect and Yidao Sect battle) to represent internal psychological states.

Abstract numbering of parts in chapters: Chapters containing multiple stages of an event are numbered with Chinese characters in parentheses, such as '夺舍道晨（一）' through '（五）', establishing a serialized, slow-burn pacing.

Syllabic and Majestic Chants: High-level characters frequently speak in short, rhythmic, four-character poetic chants (e.g. '万古一造', '荒古一造', '不破不立', '天意圣丹') which heightens the mythic, ancient atmosphere.

creation_family_evidence.Theme of Not Becoming an Immortal (不做仙/求: The core philosophical conflict where characters reject the traditional path of Xian (仙/Immortal) in favor of their own path (Mo/魔), which is reflected in Su Ming's refusal to submit to fate and his decision to possess Xuan Zang rather than yield.
creation_family_evidence.The Ninth Summit Lineage (第九峰): The presence of Huzi (虎子), Second Senior Brother (二师兄), and Bald Crane (秃毛鹤) as Su Ming's companions at the Nine Incense Burners in Chapter 1174, which directly links this segment to the core protagonist group of 《求魔》.
creation_family_evidence.The Concept of Lingxian (灵先): The unique ancient cultivation tier of 'Lingxian' (灵先) and the trial of ancestral spirit seats (先灵位) in the Hall of All Spirits, which is a major cosmological and mythological element introduced in this novel.
creation_family_evidence.The Cosmic Sang Xiang Butterfly (桑相): The macrocosmic setup where the entire world is contained within the wings of a giant butterfly (桑相) flying in the Cangmang, which is the signature cosmological design of 《求魔》.
creation_family_evidence.The Suming Clan Possession (塑冥夺舍): The unique talent of the Suming Clan (塑冥族) that allows members to possess other entities from within, which Su Ming uses to possess Xuan Zang in Chapter 1380, initiating the Ancient Zang arc.
creation_family_evidence.The Character of Bald Crane as the Seven: The revelation of Bald Crane's true identity as the Seventh Reverse Spirit (第七逆灵) or Kong Mo (孔摩), which resolves a major long-running mystery about its origin and obsession with crystals.

originality_risks: The Dream/Possession Framework as a Cop-Out: The transition of the entire setting into a dreamworld/possession illusion (the Ancient Zang Kingdom inside Xuan Zang's body) in Book 7 risks alienating readers who feel that the physical stakes of the previous six books are retroactively diminished.

Repetitive 'Genius Trial' Structure: The July Sect trial in Book 7 (Chapters 1385-1390), where Su Ming enters as a low-level disciple, obtains high scores, and shocks the elders, closely mirrors the early-volume trials (such as Wushan or Hanfeng), presenting a risk of repetitive plotting.

Over-reliance on the 'Childhood Friend Turned Enemy' Trope: The confrontation with Lei Chen (as the Sangzi butterfly) and his association with the enemy First Prince relies heavily on the trope of tragic, corrupted friendships, which can feel melodramatic if overused.

Arbitrary Cultivation Realm Inflation: The introduction of new, supreme realms such as Daoling, Daozun, and Daoshen in the Ancient Zang Kingdom, while bypassing the previous True World boundaries, can confuse readers regarding the absolute power scale established earlier.
